name: AILedNavigation
description: AILedNavigation is the left-rail navigation system for AI Led experiences. It organizes the things an AI workbench needs to surface — new chat, search, library, agents, apps, projects, pinned items, recents and account — under a single composable group. Five companion variants (default · collapsed · workspace-focused · agent-focused · minimal) and five state machines (default · nested-open · loading-recents · empty-recents · permission-restricted) cover the full life-cycle. The header reuses the canonical AIAvatar brand mark from the AI Assisted Side Drawer pattern so AI Led products share one identity across the shell.
intent: The navigation rail for AI Led product shells — inspired by modern AI tools, tuned to ZAIDYN enterprise visual language.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.
